title: A good cruise with some disappointing fellow passengers
body: Our experience on the MSC Grandiosa was generally good. The crew was without a doubt one of the biggest highlights. Everyone was very friendly, helpful, and professional. We were also satisfied with the food. It was tasty and there was plenty of choice. However, we did feel that the same dishes were offered quite often during the seven days. A little more variety would have made the experience even better. We chose the Premium Drink Package and were very happy with it. Almost everything we wanted to order was included, and the drinks were from well known, genuine brands. For us, this package is definitely worth recommending. Our inside cabin was surprisingly spacious. The only downside was that there was very little space to store our suitcases properly. Unfortunately, the cabin was also very poorly insulated. We could hear children running through the hallway, sometimes so loudly that the room seemed to shake. We could also clearly hear people shouting or arguing in the corridor, and even the television from the cabin next door. The biggest negative point for us was the behaviour of some of the other guests. Many people were very unfriendly and had poor manners. At the bar and buffet, people regularly tried to push in front of others and showed very little consideration. This really affected the atmosphere at times. Despite these issues, we still had an enjoyable cruise. The friendly crew, tasty food, and excellent drink package made up for a lot. The MSC Grandiosa is certainly a beautiful ship, but our experience would have been even better with quieter and more respectful fellow passengers.

title: Nice stay, but service could improve
body: We stayed at Disney Davy Crockett Ranch and overall had a nice experience. It is not a traditional hotel, but more of a peaceful holiday park surrounded by nature, which gives it a very calm and relaxing atmosphere. The renovated bungalows are really beautiful, well themed, practical, and much more comfortable than before. The beds were a big improvement, and having Disney+ in the bungalow was a nice extra. The pool was also fun, and the cast members in the shop were genuinely very friendly. That said, there were also a few disappointing points. The welcome at reception was not pleasant at all. The staff came across as unfriendly, rolled their eyes when we asked questions, and were not helpful. I collect Magic Passes and asked if I could get one, but that clearly seemed like too much trouble. In the end, we only received general Disneyland Paris tickets, not proper Davy Crockett Ranch ones, and when I mentioned it, I was ignored. We also only got our bungalow number at 4:30 PM, which felt very late. Another downside was the access system for the bungalow. We had to use the app via Bluetooth every time, which felt unnecessarily complicated. It would be much easier if this worked through Apple Wallet or a proper Magic Pass, like in Walt Disney World. The barbecue was also still dirty from the previous guests, which should really have been cleaned before arrival. Finally, apart from the pool, there are not many activities at the resort. It would be nice if there were a few more things to do, such as mini golf or other leisure activities. Overall, it is a lovely and peaceful place to stay, especially because of the bungalows and the atmosphere, but the reception experience and some practical details definitely need improvement.
